decisionLog.decision: Combined server-side endpoint POST /api/sessions/{id}/revert (stage -> re-read authoritative state -> commit in one request) chosen over client-side chaining of /revert/stage + /revert/commit; the client confirm dialog carries user intent while the existing confirmation guard (sessionID+updated) pins the action to the observed session state. Fingerprint retyping removed as client-only friction.
